title: Adult skills, workplace use and earnings in USA and Japan

equation_quality.supported_scope: See exact linked equations and parameter states; successful replay is not mechanism identification.

independent_units.independent_unit_description: Respondents nested in country and deterministic ten hashblocks; not10 independent samples from plausible values. Repeated respondent information stays linked. Survey clustering not publicly fully reconstructible.

calibration_burden: Respondent hashblocks within both countries; no held respondent wage fitting. Country intercepts use training respondents in that same country. No transfer to an unseen economy.

baseline_strength.scope: Matched task/input access; historical controls are not claimed to exhaust state of the art.
